name: Adventure Fantasy
audience: Explorers seeking legible landmarks and a sense of discovery.
camera: Third-person exploration with medium-to-long landmark views.
identity: Woven arch motifs and staggered stone ribs repeat across an original ruined-waystation culture.

palette.rule: Keep navigation lights cooler than treasure glows; reinforce differences with silhouette and motion.

geometry: Strong architectural tiers and varied but coherent erosion; paths remain readable through clutter.

materials.surfaces: Weathered stone, woven fiber and oxidized metal with restrained hand-shaped variation.
materials.texture_rule: Mid-frequency wear follows edges and contact points, never uniform noise.
materials.tiling_rule: Blend repeated stone with decals or modular breakup; test 3x3 and long sightlines.

lighting: Warm directional sun against cool ambient recesses; entrances and objectives retain contrast.
effects: Sparse dust and rune glints at points of interest; no constant opaque fog on objectives.
ui: Map-like borders and compact glyphs backed by plain text; maintain mobile readability.
audio: Layered wind, wood and low strings; objective cues remain distinct from ambience.

budgets.reuse_rule: Build landmark kits from reusable arches, ribs and stone trims with limited variants.

originality: Create a new culture and insignia; avoid named fantasy universes, borrowed maps or recognizable quest icons.
